title: Research: any-register A5 conjugate 5-cycle four-call floor (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers the algebraic-invariant open question of merged [#2246](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2246) (`a5-conjugate-5cycle-seedd316f8`): does an algebraic invariant give the same four-call floor for every finite number of arbitrary dirty spectator registers in this fixed A5 alphabet?

**Yes, for every finite `r≥2`.** In `M_r(F₂[A₅])` with paid labels `{x,y}` (`x=(1 2)(3 4)`, `y=(1 3 5)`) and every binary rank-one idempotent, the target `diag([xy],[yx],[e],…,[e])` has exact paid-call minimum **4**:

- The direct word `D_{E₀₀}(x) D_{E₀₀}(y) D_{E₁₁}(y) D_{E₁₁}(x)` attains the target for every `r≥2`.
- Support filter: among all words of length ≤3 over `{x,y}`, only `xyx` and `yxy` have subsequence-support containing both 5-cycles.
- Each of those patterns forces the middle projector `B = E₀₀+E₁₁`, which has **rank 2** and is therefore outside the rank-one paid alphabet.

This replaces a deferred width-4 BFS census of the same endpoint (not opened as a separate PR). **No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. Does not claim a BIT supplier.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/a5-conjugate-any-registers/`
- Tip: `73a96c95cb86c6615d7809664dd92ec2eb9bb900`
- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`
- Scope: **refined** — algebraic any-register floor answering #2246 OQ

Closest prior: [#2246](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2246) (two-/three-role minimum 4; unpaid invariant). Soft overlap ≈0.17–0.26 vs that census (method is support+coefficient, not BFS). Shared claim language with the deferred width-4 census is not a method reprint.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/a5-conjugate-any-registers/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/a5-conjugate-any-registers/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/a5-conjugate-any-registers/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/a5-conjugate-any-registers/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a5-conjugate-any-registers
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_A5_CONJUGATE_ANY_REGISTERS minimum=4 roles=all_finite_r>=2 support_patterns=['xyx','yxy'] forced_B_rank=2 direct_roles=[2, 3, 4, 5] no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_A5_CONJUGATE_ANY_REGISTERS even_permutations=60 support_patterns=['xyx','yxy'] forced_B_outside_rank_one direct_roles=[2, 3, 4, 5] no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/a5-conjugate-any-registers outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions / limitations

1. Is there a priced native address-operation realization of this A5 (2,3,5) alphabet inside an admitted BIT supplier?
2. Does the same support-plus-middle-projector pattern give any-register floors for other perfect-group conjugate-pair alphabets?
3. Finite role controls (`r∈{2,3,4,5,8}`) corroborate the r-parametric forcing; the theorem itself is not a finite census.
